files.description: Playwright tests for the Index Photos utility: streaming scan statistics, and a full unindexed->import->orphaned->cleanup sync round-trip driven by dropping/removing a real file in the media directory.

testContext: /utilities/index-photos renders the shell instantly, then streams the scan as NDJSON: progress records tick #stat-total-filesystem; the final done record fills #stat-total-imported/#stat-total-indexed/#stat-unindexed/#stat-orphaned (all start as em-dash), renders #scan-results (either .empty-state 'Everything is in sync' or 'Unindexed Photos'/'Orphaned Database Entries' .section tables), and reveals #sync-button when there is work. The Flask server and the test process share a filesystem, so setup uses node:fs: copy an existing JPEG into the media dir (read from /settings .media-dir-path) with appended marker bytes so hashing can't dedupe it. Sync POSTs /utilities/index-photos/scan-held lists to /utilities/index-photos/sync (202) and the page reloads; import runs behind the shared taskq worker and can queue behind minutes of CLIP work from parallel suites, so waits are generous (toPass 360s re-loading the page). Assert the settled in-sync UI on ONE MORE clean page load — a load racing the finishing import reveals #sync-button one-way. Deleting the file makes the next scan report the row as orphaned with reason 'File deleted from disk'; syncing removes it, returning the sandbox to baseline. Per-tick 'live counter' updates are not observable on a 17-photo library, so the populated end state is the contract. The 'no media directories' empty state is deliberately not exercised: removing the seeded dir risks the hourly file_sync automation deleting every media row as 'unconfigured'. The isolated environment runs NO filesystem watcher (watcher only exists under YAFFO_ROLE dispatch), so dropped files stay unindexed until an explicit sync. App fix that this suite depends on: static/base.css now has [hidden]{display:none !important} — previously .btn/button[data-icon] display rules silently un-hid the hidden-by-default Sync button.
explanation: Generated manually from specs/index_photos.yaml after inspecting templates/utilities/index_photos.html, routes/utilities/index_photos.py, static/utilities/index_photos.js, and yaffo/__main__.py (watcher roles). Uncovered and fixed a real app bug: author CSS display rules (button.css .btn, icons.css button[data-icon]) outranked the UA's [hidden] rule, keeping the Sync Database button always visible; fixed with a global [hidden]{display:none !important} reset in static/base.css. Validated with typecheck and green runs both solo and inside the full parallel suite.
